name: Reactive stablecoin-inflow FADE short (4h, RSI-overbought + rising volatility)
rationale: MECHANISM: reactive inflows that LAG price mark late money; when that late inflow lands on an RSI-overbought tape with rising realized volatility (vol_realized), the up-move is running on fumes and fresh, structurally-late purchasing power is the last buyer. Entry: stablecoin_net_flow_usd spike AND rsi overbought AND vol_realized elevated — short. Distinct from variant 07 (bb_z + ret extension): here overextension is read via RSI and the fade is conditioned on a volatility expansion (blow-off character). Other side = trend-chasers buying the top. DISCONFIRMER: if the fade also works when the inflow lands on a neutral RSI, the flow feature is decorative and it is a generic RSI short. Kill if net-of-fees the short cannot beat crypto's long-drift + the cost of shorting into a still-rising tape.
catalyst: reactive stablecoin inflow into an RSI-overbought, volatility-expanding 4h top
